payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: April, Jung, Kelle, Linnea, Nickole, Tawna

payload.content: Hi everyone, I'm Linnea. My availability is 4.0. My top skills are security (0.98) and frontend (0.70). I'm interested in the following tasks (in order of my lowest cost): ISSUE-0002::review, ISSUE-0002::test, ISSUE-0002::implement, ISSUE-0001::triage, ISSUE-0001::review, ISSUE-0001::docs. Let me know your preferences so we can avoid overlaps.

Hi everyone, I'm Tawna. Availability: 10.0. Skills: frontend (0.72), security (0.67). My lowest cost tasks are: ISSUE-0002::review (1.23), ISSUE-0002::test (1.72), ISSUE-0002::implement (2.45), and ISSUE-0001::triage (3.66). Linnea, since you have lower availability (4.0), maybe you should take one of the ISSUE-0002 tasks and I can take something else. I'll wait to hear from the others. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi everyone, I'm April. Availability: 10.0. Skills: security (0.95), frontend (0.83). My costs are lowest for ISSUE-0002 tasks (review: 1.08, test: 1.51, implement: 2.15), but I have high security skills and could take ISSUE-0001::implement (cost 6.65) if needed, since I have the availability. Linnea, with your high security skill and lower availability, maybe you'd like ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs? Tawna, do you want to grab one of the frontend tasks in ISSUE-0002? Waiting to hear from Jung, Kelle, and Nickole. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi everyone, I'm Kelle. Availability: 10.0. My top skill is security (0.71). My lowest cost tasks are all in ISSUE-0001: triage (3.45), review (4.31), docs (4.31), and test (6.03). My costs for ISSUE-0002 are quite high (10.0+).

Since April has high security skills and availability, April taking ISSUE-0001::implement seems like a good move. I could take ISSUE-0001::test or ISSUE-0001::docs/triage depending on what Nickole and Jung prefer. Linnea and Tawna, you both seem to have lower costs for ISSUE-0002, so maybe you can split those?
